text:
Priya Nambiar: Quick sync — planning sprint scenarios for regional guardrails & launch handoff. Goal: produce a simulation-backed acceptance checklist for cross-region routing, tenant isolation, and customer cutover. Need tradeoffs and owners. Ideas?

Tom Lee: +1. We should run 3 simulation classes: normal load, tenant surge, region outage. Measure p95 latency, error rate, and eviction time.

Ana Gómez: customer asks: "Can we guarantee data stays in EU?" Suggest region-pinning with strict fallback to same jurisdiction; fallback to global only after configurable grace period. Also highlight config UI flag.

Kevin Chu: Draft acceptance criteria proposal:
- p95 latency <= 200ms for hosted tier
- failover to secondary region within 30s
- no more than 0.1% of requests returning 5xx during cutover
- canary rollout with 5% traffic and automatic rollback on regressions
Also list dependencies: infra routing templates, auth for cross-region s3, telemetry labels.

Priya Nambiar: Nice. Add simulation pass/fail thresholds and decision matrix. Also note contractual SLA exceptions for Dedicated customers.

Tom Lee: I started a smoke sim job: sim/job/2026-03-22/regional-guardrails-1 — results ETA EOD.

SRE-Bot: Job sim-5587654321 queued and running on runner-8. Logs: https://ci.internal/sim/5587654321

Ana Gómez: UI/UX note: we need a "routing policy explainer" for sales + support. Minimal fields: region preference, latency threshold, isolation level (soft/hard), fallback policy.

Kevin Chu: Quick config sketch:
```yaml
routing_policy:
  region_preference: ["eu-west-1", "eu-central-1"]
  isolation: hard
  fallback:
    policy: staged
    grace_seconds: 60
    max_failover_pct: 10
```

Priya Nambiar: Action items:
- Tom: finish sims + post csv of latency/error by 3pm (owner: Tom Lee)
- Kevin: write acceptance checklist PR with rollback playbook (owner: Kevin Chu)
- Ana: draft routing explainer for customer-facing docs and sales one-pager (owner: Ana Gómez)
We'll meet tomorrow 10am to review and decide gates. @Kevin Chu please add the canary thresholds to the PR.

Kevin Chu: Will do. Also flagging product question — do we expose "hard isolation" for Hosted customers or only Dedicated? Need decision from PMs.

Priya Nambiar: For now add it behind feature flag for Hosted; final decision by PMs during review. OK team, thanks :thumbsup:
